messages:
danielle: quick heads-up 1 Carlos is on an L-1B and his extension petition was filed last week. tentative return-to-office plan has him remote from TX for 6 weeks starting 2024-09-02. need to confirm payroll/tax and any immigration impact.

carlos: hi all 1 i'm the employee here. my attorney filed extension (premium not elected) on 2024-08-01. petition receipt says case received. travel is only domestic (moving between CA and TX). will that trigger anything?

imm-legal: domestic travel doesn't affect L-1 status, but remote work across states can create state tax nexus and may affect wage statement requirements. immigration-wise, as long as petition remains pending and employer maintains terms, no additional filing needed for remote within US. if change is permanent, we should note worksite address in the amendment if >30% of time.

tax: flagging state withholding: TX has no income tax, CA does. payroll needs the correct state setup based on work location. if Carlos will be physically working in TX for 6 weeks, we should update payroll for TX withholding during that period. need dates and qualifying address. also, check local payroll registration if this becomes recurring.

payroll: to implement: please submit a temporary worksite change form with start/end dates and the TX address. once we have that, we'll set TX withholding and stop CA withholding for the period. we can reverse after 6 weeks. send to payroll@redwood.com. note: benefits remain under primary worksite (CA) unless employee changes residence.

danielle: action items for people-ops: 1) collect temporary worksite form from Carlos 2) notify payroll of exact dates 3) notify tax of potential nexus if this becomes frequent 4) confirm immigration counsel's note in the employee file.

carlos: i'll fill out the worksite form today and upload a copy of the USCIS receipt to the portal. one Q: does the pending extension affect eligibility for paid time off or payroll processing?

payroll: pending extension doesn't block payroll. we process pay as usual. only caveat is we cannot change visa status in HR system until approval; but compensation continues. if extension is denied, we'll consult legal on next steps.

imm-legal: we'll add a note to the case file: temporary remote assignment 2024-09-02 to 2024-10-13. no amendment required for this short-term remote. if time outside CA exceeds 180 days in a year, re-evaluate.

people-ops-bot: [TASK CREATED] Temporary worksite change: Carlos 1 due 2024-08-15 

danielle: great. Carlos, ping here when you upload the form and the receipt. i'll confirm payroll update once they acknowledge. :thumbsup:
